name: The EOA
caption: Lost the promotion's own inaugural Tag Team Title match to the Perfectly Perfect Duo.

tenures.source: Loses the promotion's own first-ever Tag Team Title match on Saturday Night Showcase (25 April 1998).

name: Teen Angst
caption: Won a four-way dance to earn a Tag Team Title shot, fought the champions to a draw, then dethroned them weeks later with a bell-ringing distraction.

tenures.source: Wins a four-way dance and fights the champions to a double countout draw at Spring Fest 98 (31 May 1998); wins the World Tag Team Championship at Boston Massacre (27 June 1998); retains it at the promotion's own final surviving broadcast.

name: Perfectly Perfect Duo
caption: The promotion's own first-ever World Tag Team Champions, who held the belts through a controversial draw before losing them to Teen Angst at Boston Massacre.

tenures.source: Wins the promotion's own first-ever Tag Team Title match on Saturday Night Showcase (25 April 1998); retains against Teen Angst by double countout at Spring Fest 98 (31 May 1998); loses the titles to Teen Angst at Boston Massacre (27 June 1998).
